title: Orden o inestabilidad
goal: Read about the book that framed caudillos as pure barbarism, and the indigenous-backed caudillo whose case doesn't fit that framing at all.

items: Explain what Sarmiento argued in 'Facundo: Civilización y Barbarie'.
Explain why Rafael Carrera's case complicates Sarmiento's interpretation.
Describe the alternative interpretation some historians prefer today.
Explain why neither interpretation fully captures every case.
Use 'a raíz de' and 'en el marco de' to compare two historical interpretations.
